description: Plan, apply, or restore a translation. The default is a read-only dry run.
help_translation_file: Translation JSON with embedded runtime settings
help_package_dir: Directory containing binary assets (default: JSON parent)
help_transaction_dir: Directory for the operation journal and restore data
help_ui_language: Language of application messages (independent of translation language)
help_boundary: Optional part boundary; must match the embedded settings
missing_pending: Missing translations: {count} (a detailed report is written when applying).
plan_summary: Plan: {resources} resources; {files} archive parts; {bytes} bytes of restore data; sufficient space: {space}.
dry_run: Dry run only; game files were not modified.
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed. Diagnostic report: {path}
diagnostic_failed: The operation failed ({type}); the diagnostic report could not be saved.
help_help: Show this help message and exit
help_local_config: Machine-local path configuration (default: pytrtt.local.toml in working directory)
help_game_selector: Game identifier for local paths when restoring without a translation document
gui_status_browse: The game was not found automatically. Browse for its directory.
gui_status_not_found: The selected directory does not exist.
gui_status_no_package: No translation package is available for this game.
gui_status_ready: The game installation was found. Its translation status will now be checked.
gui_status_checking: Checking the game files… This may take a few minutes; no files are changed during the check.
gui_status_changes: The game is ready for translation. You can install the translation in the next step.
gui_status_translated: This translation is already installed; no file changes are needed.
gui_status_error: The installation could not be verified.
gui_status_unknown_modified: The game files differ from the known original and translated states.
gui_unknown_detail: PyTRTT did not modify the game. Restore a known transaction or verify the game files in Steam before trying again. Technical detail: {detail}
gui_missing: Missing translation entries: {count}. No game files were modified.
gui_select_game_help: Select an installed game. PyTRTT searches Steam automatically, or you can browse for the installation directory.
gui_select_action_help: Choose what PyTRTT should do with the selected game.
gui_action_check_help: Checks the translation package and prepares the complete installation plan without modifying or installing any game files.
gui_action_not_available: This action will be enabled after safe state detection is implemented.
gui_action_install_ready: The translation is ready to install. A recovery backup will be created before any changes.
gui_action_restore_ready: A matching applied transaction is available for safe restoration.
gui_action_restore_unsafe: The translation is installed, but no transaction matches the current complete file state. Restoration is disabled to preserve other mods.
gui_status_restored: The original game resources were restored.
gui_restored_detail: The restoration finished successfully. Other files were not intentionally modified.
gui_progress_help: Please wait while PyTRTT checks the selected installation.
gui_progress_install: Creating a recovery backup and installing the translation…
gui_exit_title: Would you like to stop the operation?
gui_exit_message: PyTRTT is currently modifying game files. Choose how you would like to continue.
gui_exit_continue_help: The translation continues and nothing else changes.
gui_exit_safe_help: PyTRTT safely restores the original files and then closes. This may take a few minutes.
gui_exit_force_help: The application closes immediately. Recovery may be required the next time it starts.
gui_exit_force_title: Are you sure you want to exit immediately?
gui_exit_force_message: The operation has not finished. Recovery backups will be kept, but the game may not start until recovery is complete. Continue at your own risk.
gui_exit_safe_wait: Stopping safely and restoring the original game files…
gui_exit_restore_message: PyTRTT is restoring the game files to a safe state. It can close automatically when recovery has finished.
gui_recovery_message: PyTRTT found {count} interrupted operation(s). The game files need to be restored to a safe state. Recovery backups are available. Start recovery now?
gui_recovery_complete_message: The game files are in a safe state again.
gui_recovery_error_message: PyTRTT kept the recovery backups. Technical detail: {detail}
gui_launch_error_title: The game could not be started
gui_launch_error_message: Open the game from its launcher and try again.
gui_complete_help: The operation has finished. You can go back, start over, or exit.
